$comment: Listing fields that apify push never sends, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs after every deploy.
actorId$comment: Pinned by ID: CI pushes to this ID and store-metadata.mjs looks it up by ID, so the name in actor.json renames the same actor (created as meta-ad-library-probe on 2026-09-25).
seoTitle: Facebook/Meta Ads Library Scraper - Winning Ads
seoDescription: Scrape the Facebook/Meta Ads Library, no login: winning ads, landing pages, creatives, advertiser leads, scam checks. $0.70 per 1,000 ads, no start fee.
isPublic$comment: Published 2026-09-27 (build 1.0.6+) after the platform tests: 8 runs across every mode, 4 paid runs with charges equal to delivered data (a $0.01 limit stopped at 14 ads), and the example input in 16 s. A paid public actor cannot be made private again until monetization is cancelled in Console.
defaultRunOptions$comment: 256 MB: the library waits on the network (peak about 60 MB locally). 3600 s: one residential session reads about 90 ads a minute.

pricing.$comment: CONFIRMED by measurement 2026-09-25 (owner rule: a little below the main competitor, extreme margin) per the owner rule (a little below the main competitor, extreme margin); applied after the platform cost test. ad $0.0007 = just under curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper $0.00075 (5,853 u30, 1.7M runs/30d, 4.8 stars) and far under apify/facebook-ads-scraper $0.0058 (6,040 u30); measured cost ~$0.037 per 1,000 ads over residential proxy (probe run OXsR97F8iiWabhPov) = ~19x margin before Apify 20%. advertiser $0.008 = just under the $0.01 advertiser-found price of the lead-finder actors (berkaydev; jurassic_jove charges $0.07). MEASURED on Apify (build 1.0.2, 7 runs, settled usage): $0.069 per 1,000 ads overall ($0.044-0.054 on 150-200 ad runs; fixed ~$0.002 per run from the first residential page load), so $0.70/1k keeps ~8x after Apify 20%; advertiser rows cost $0.051/1k -> 126x; the scam check costs $0.155/1k (official-page lookups, 7 sessions) -> scam-check-ad $0.002 (no competitor offers it) keeps ~10x. Store discounts (owner's Gentle ladder, rolled out 2026-10-29 after holehe and social-analyzer): Free and Starter keep the flat price, Scale pays 10% less, Business and above 20% less; apify-actor-start stays flat. Aug-Oct paid revenue of this actor came almost all from Starter, and Apify bills our platform cost of Scale and Business runs lower only when discounts are on (compute $0.16 and $0.13 per CU instead of $0.20, https://docs.apify.com/actors/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md). The CI script applies first-time pricing and decreases; increases go through Console with 14 days' notice.

ad.eventDescription: One ad row: advertiser, days running, versions, text, headline, button, landing page and domain, image and video links, platforms, and the reach, spend and EU audience data Meta shows. Charged as each batch is saved. No start fee.

advertiser.eventDescription: One advertiser row in the Advertiser list: page, likes, active ads found, longest-running ad, websites the ads send people to, platforms and a link to all its ads.

scam-check-ad.eventDescription: One ad row of the brand scam check: an ad that uses the brand from a page that is not the brand's own, with its risk level and signals. The check first reads the brand's official pages to learn their real websites.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: Store discounts: Scale plans pay 10% less and Business and enterprise plans 20% less. Free and Starter prices are unchanged.
